note: Spawn-weighted library chances for the training sample. Drop chance unit is 1000000, the same unit as data/catalog.json. Kills are split by spawn count on the map. Orange Mushroom Cap is 450000/1000000 on Orange Mushroom, which is 15 of 37 spawns on map 104030001, so 0.45 * 15/37. Red Potion is 22500/1000000 on every spawn of that map, so 0.0225. This file does not replace data/catalog.json.
